runbooks.title: Replica apply stopped
runbooks.content: High replica lag with healthy primary commits requires inspecting apply errors. Repair the replica before serving consistency-sensitive reads.

oracle.root_cause: A conflicting index-migration row stopped replica apply, causing 410-second stale ledger reads.
